title.en: the thursday antiques market on calle feria.
title.de: der donnerstagsmarkt mit antiquitäten in der calle feria.

line.en: antiques and second-hand stalls along calle feria every thursday morning. cafés and restaurants on the surrounding streets for after.
line.de: antiquitäten und gebrauchtwaren entlang der calle feria, jeden donnerstagvormittag. cafés und restaurants in den umliegenden straßen für danach.
line.tr: her perşembe sabahı calle feria boyunca antika ve ikinci el tezgâhlar. sonrası için çevredeki sokaklarda kafeler ve restoranlar.

sparks.why: El Mercadillo del Jueves on calle Feria 109 (Casco Antiguo), Thursdays from 08:30 per hotel and mercadillos.org listings; one hotel listing gives a 19:30 close, so the closing time is unconfirmed. 3 Dec 2026 is a Thursday.
